vbeParameter

Source: R/parameter.R
VBEParameter.Rd

Initialize a VBEParameter object.

vbeParameter(
  pathInReferenceSimulation,
  pathInTestSimulation,
  displayName = NULL,
  dimension,
  unit,
  lowerBound = 0.1,
  upperBound = 10,
  logIncrement = TRUE
)

Arguments

pathInReferenceSimulation

Character. Path to the parameter in the reference simulation.

pathInTestSimulation

Character. Path to the parameter in the test simulation.

displayName

Character. Display name of the parameter (defaults to pathInReferenceSimulation).

dimension

Character. Dimension of the parameter.

unit

Character. Unit of the parameter.

lowerBound

Numeric. Lower bound for the parameter (default: 1e-1).

upperBound

Numeric. Upper bound for the parameter (default: 1e1).

logIncrement

Logical. Whether the parameter is incremented log-arithmically (default: TRUE).

Value

A character vector of parameter paths in the test simulation.
